text: Here, among the glass walls and the soft hum of technology, the atmosphere feels measured and contemplative. Moving from the sterile open room into this vibrant exhibit space, I experience a subtle awe. The vivid orange and blue wall, emblazoned with 'R+D', invites curiosity regarding humanity's evolving relationship with technology. It feels as if I am standing in the crossroads of progress, where thought meets experimentation. There is a sense of anticipation, as if every display holds a new way to interpret the world and our place in it.
